name: spellkave_end_turn
label: Spellkave End Turn
description: End the connected actor's current turn in the in-world turn/scene (not the MCP connection), without supplying a session id. The world resolves active participation and rejects no-session/off-turn calls (`no_session` still allows exploration; or it is not your turn). NOTE: advancing the turn does NOT refresh the new current actor's available actions — only turn-gated (action-economy) rows are recomputed on a turn boundary; other available actions stay whatever they were. Movement is unaffected either way: spellkave_scene's exits are always current, so they are never stale from a missed refresh. On dispatch, the result carries `receipt` (what the world did) and a sibling `observation` (a fixed 'Your turn ends.' line on success, or 'Nothing happens.' on rejection). On a successful advance, the receipt also carries the NEW in-world `session` block (`in_session`/`current_actor`/`my_turn`) — whose turn it is next in that scene, not the MCP connection.
